The '''Four-and-a-Half''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Straddling levels 124 and 125 in [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]], there was no official record that it existed, and it was illegal to enter it. [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]], [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] fights, [[Hintaro/Legends|hintaro]], and [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] could be found in the establishment. [[Yawrocca]] was considered the reigning dejarik champion of the cantina.
